'''2016 MPC Barry Alperstein DS Senate Occupied''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Barry Alperstein]] at [[2016 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Barry Alperstein]]
* '''Event:''' [[2016 Match Play Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|My Lord, Is That Legal? / I Will Make It Legal|Cor-D-mylordisthatlegal.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open Senate Occupied Alperstein DS 2016.txt |Download]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2016-match-play-championship/ PC list] Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261013163128/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2016-match-play-championship.html Internet Archive]
